FINAL LIVE REPLICATION / STACK DISPOSITION

Containment commit 24386a026 is merged on origin/main. Gerrit 1129 PS4 passed run 30677798166 with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, then merged as dcd594cd6 at 2026-08-01T01:40:28Z. This establishes the fake-pagination repair on main.

A fresh rebase of downstream 1130 (PS5 ca0d08354) completed run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30678399352 in about 16m24s instead of hanging. Every matrix cell terminated normally: Ubuntu 3.11 default suite 4m20s, Ubuntu 3.12 5m48s, Ubuntu 3.13 6m18s, macOS 3.13 12m15s. All four reported the same three ordinary failures in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_write_ahead_recovery.py. Thus the stuck-run mechanism is gone through the next stacked revision; the new 60-minute job timeout was not exercised.

The three failures belong to existing in-progress ticket 21fc / Gerrit 1130: that change deliberately replaced immediate first-miss unbind with grace-window + corroborated misses, while three older tests still encode immediate unbind or reuse a store polluted by the now-retained pending entry. CI is correctly Verified -1; LLM-Review is +1. Ticket 21fc is claimed by another session, so no code was changed here and dependent 1131/1136 were not rebased across a red prerequisite.

Performance decision remains: keep the affected pager-contract test in the unit/default suite. Across 12 healthy historical cells it was below the slowest-25 cutoff (2.40-4.85s), far below the one-minute threshold.
